name: main-integration
body: The integration of a change-set into main: the single, gated act by which a project branch's work reaches the main checkout — `apg project merge <name>` (verify gate → merge → main rebuild → self-clean). No agent integrates a change-set by raw git (merge/checkout/switch/worktree add-remove on main). Scope of the git statement: it concerns the NAVIGATOR's raw git use only — the navigator's sole branch-state-mutating raw git command is rebasing the project worktree onto main, run inside the worktree. It does not describe other agents' main writes, which are separate, explicit carve-outs outside change-set integration: the `agent-builder` commits `.opencode/agents/**` on main, and the optional `release-agent` (user-consented) performs `git push`/`git tag` as `ask`.
